# Overview

This document evaluates RAMClustR's compound clustering against the
compound-centric, tier-stratified reference feature set from MS1Match on SuperPool. All
reference-relative counts come from `evaluate_grouping()`. This is the same
function, with the same definitions, used for CAMERA
(`SuperPool_CAMERA_evaluation.Rmd`) and in vignette 3.

For each compound, the Tier 1a `[M+H]+` feature is the **anchor**; the cluster
RAMClustR assigns to it is the compound's expected cluster. Every reference compound
has an anchor by construction.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| *Reference features (first status that applies):* | |
| Ref-unassigned (no-anchor) | RAMClustR did not cluster the compound's anchor; none of its features can be evaluated |
| Ref-unassigned | The anchor is clustered, this feature is not |
| Ref-confirmed | Same cluster as its compound's anchor |
| Ref-conflicting | Different cluster than its compound's anchor |
| *Features outside the reference feature set:* | |
| Ref-unmatched, co-grouped | In a cluster with a compound anchor (possible over-grouping) |
| Ref-unmatched, unrelated | In a cluster without an anchor, or in no cluster |

Unlike CAMERA, RAMClustR does not cluster every feature. The two
Ref-unassigned statuses therefore matter here. The benchmark also reports
**coverage**: the share of reference features RAMClustR clustered at all.

## Load packages

```{r packages}
library(MS1Match)
library(RAMClustR)
library(xcms)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

## Load data

`anno_result` must have been built on the feature table passed as
`feature_table` below. In vignette 2b, this is the xcms feature table
filtered to the 60–1200 s RT window.

```{r load-data}
data_dir <- system.file("extdata", "RDS_files", "SuperPool", package = "MS1Match")

out <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "SuperPool_MS1MS2_result.rds"))

# The feature table MS1Match was run on (vignette 2b)
pool_FT_sub <- out$ft %>% filter(rtmed >= 60 & rtmed <= 1200)

anno_result <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "anno_result_SuperPool.rds"))
```

---

# Step 1 — RAMClustR clustering

RAMClustR runs on the same xcms object as MS1Match, so both share feature
ids. The cached result is loaded if it exists; otherwise the clustering is
run and saved.

```{r ramclustr-run, results = "hide"}
rc_cache_path <- file.path(data_dir, "RC_superpool.rds")

if (file.exists(rc_cache_path)) {
  RC <- readRDS(rc_cache_path)
} else {
  x_exp_converted <- as(out$result$x_exp, "XCMSnExp")
  experiment      <- defineExperiment(force.skip = TRUE)

  RC <- ramclustR(
    xcmsObj = x_exp_converted,
    ExpDes  = experiment,
    st      = 5,
    sr      = 0.7,
    maxt    = 10,
    mzdec   = 4
  )
  saveRDS(RC, "RC_superpool.rds")
}
```

---

# Step 2 — Grouping table

`ramclustr_to_grouping()` gives one row per feature. Its `group` column is
the RAMClustR compound label (`C001`, ...). Features RAMClustR did not
cluster (`featclus = 0`) get `group = NA`.

```{r grouping-table}
grouping_rc <- ramclustr_to_grouping(RC)

cat("Features:            ", nrow(grouping_rc), "\n")
cat("Clustered features:  ", sum(!is.na(grouping_rc$group)), "\n")
cat("RAMClustR clusters:  ", n_distinct(grouping_rc$group, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

---

# Step 3 — Same feature table?

```{r feature-match}
check_feature_match(anno_result, grouping_rc, pool_FT_sub)
```

RAMClustR ran on the full feature table, MS1Match on the RT-truncated one.
The features outside 60–1200 s are therefore reported as "only in grouping
table" and excluded.

---

# Step 4 — Evaluate

```{r evaluate}
eval_rc <- evaluate_grouping(
  anno_result, grouping_rc,
  tool_name     = "RAMClustR",
  feature_table = pool_FT_sub,
  rt_window     = c(60, 1200)     # same window as for CAMERA
)
eval_rc
```

---

# Step 5 — Tier benchmark

```{r benchmark-check}
bm <- eval_rc$benchmark

# every reference row falls into exactly one status
stopifnot(with(bm, n_confirmed + n_conflicting + n_unassigned +
                   n_no_anchor + n_not_evaluable == n_ref))
```

```{r benchmark-table}
.n_pct <- function(n, pct) sprintf("%d (%.1f %%)", as.integer(n), pct)

bm_display <- bm %>%
  transmute(
    Tier,
    `Ref set`                    = n_ref,
    `Coverage`                   = sprintf("%.1f %%", pct_grouped),
    `Ref-unassigned (no-anchor)` = .n_pct(n_no_anchor,   pct_no_anchor),
    `Ref-unassigned`             = .n_pct(n_unassigned,  pct_unassigned),
    `Ref-confirmed`              = .n_pct(n_confirmed,   pct_confirmed),
    `Ref-conflicting`            = .n_pct(n_conflicting, pct_conflicting)
  )

k <- bm_display %>%
  kable(caption = paste("RAMClustR tier-stratified benchmark against the",
                        "compound-centric reference feature set (SuperPool, MS1Match)."),
        align = c("l", rep("r", ncol(bm_display) - 1))) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, position = "left", font_size = 13) %>%
  row_spec(nrow(bm_display), bold = TRUE)

exp_rows <- which(grepl("_exp$", bm_display$Tier))
if (length(exp_rows) > 0L) k <- row_spec(k, exp_rows, italic = TRUE)

k %>%
  footnote(general = c(
    "Ref set = reference feature x compound rows in that tier (best tier per feature x compound).",
    "Coverage = reference features RAMClustR clustered at all / Ref set.",
    "Each reference feature gets the first status that applies, in the column order; % of Ref set.",
    "Ref-unassigned (no-anchor) = the compound's Tier 1a [M+H]+ anchor was not clustered.",
    "Ref-unassigned = the anchor is clustered, this feature is not.",
    "Ref-confirmed / Ref-conflicting = in the same / a different cluster than the anchor.",
    "Total row: feature-weighted sums across tiers. Italic rows: Phase 2 expansion tiers.",
    "Annotation coverage and accuracy not applicable: RAMClustR groups features but does not annotate adducts."
  )) %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%")
```

---

# Step 6 — Status over all features

This step includes the features outside the reference feature set, within the same
60–1200 s window as for CAMERA.

```{r status-counts}
status_def <- data.frame(
  ref_status = c("Ref-unassigned (no-anchor)", "Ref-unassigned",
                 "Ref-confirmed", "Ref-conflicting", "Not evaluable",
                 "Ref-unmatched, co-grouped", "Ref-unmatched, unrelated"),
  definition = c(
    "Reference entry; the compound's anchor is not clustered",
    "Reference entry; anchor clustered, this feature not",
    "Same cluster as its compound's anchor",
    "Different cluster than its compound's anchor",
    "Technical check, should be 0: no anchor in the shared feature table",
    "No reference entry; cluster contains a compound anchor (possible over-grouping)",
    "No reference entry; cluster without an anchor, or no cluster"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

eval_rc$status_counts %>%
  left_join(status_def, by = "ref_status") %>%
  kable(caption   = "Reference-relative status of all RAMClustR features (SuperPool)",
        col.names = c("Status", "n", "% of all rows", "Definition")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed")) %>%
  footnote(general = paste(
    "Rows = reference feature x compound assignments plus RAMClustR features",
    "outside the reference feature set (RT 60-1200 s)."))
```

---

# Step 7 — Per-compound view and spot checks

## RAMClustR clusters per reference compound

```{r clusters-per-compound}
ref_rows <- eval_rc$full_table %>% filter(!is.na(Compound_name))

clusters_per_compound <- ref_rows %>%
  group_by(Compound_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n_features      = n(),
    n_clusters      = n_distinct(group, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_unclustered   = sum(is.na(group)),
    n_ref_confirmed = sum(ref_status == "Ref-confirmed"),
    anchor_cluster  = first(anchor_group),
    clusters        = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(group))), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_features))

clusters_per_compound
```

## Spot checks

```{r spot-checks}
spot_compound <- "L-Methionine"
spot_cluster  <- "C013"

# all reference features of one compound
ref_rows %>%
  filter(Compound_name %in% spot_compound) %>%
  left_join(grouping_rc %>% select(feature_name, mz, rt), by = "feature_name") %>%
  select(feature_name, mz, rt, tier, group, anchor_feature, anchor_group, ref_status) %>%
  arrange(mz)

# all features of one RAMClustR cluster, with their status
grouping_rc %>%
  filter(group %in% spot_cluster) %>%
  left_join(eval_rc$full_table %>%
              select(feature_name, Compound_name, tier, ref_status),
            by = "feature_name") %>%
  arrange(mz)
```

---

# Step 8 — Export

The export tables add RAMClustR-specific columns on top of
`eval_rc$full_table`:

- the MS1Match evidence;
- the number of compound anchors in the anchor cluster (purity);
- the share of the anchor cluster that is the compound's own Ref-confirmed
  features.

The statuses themselves are not recomputed.

```{r export-tables}
.combine_str <- function(...) {
  m <- do.call(cbind, lapply(list(...), as.character))
  m[!is.na(m) & m == ""] <- NA_character_
  apply(m, 1, function(v) {
    v <- v[!is.na(v)]
    if (length(v) > 0L) paste(v, collapse = "; ") else NA_character_
  })
}

ft <- eval_rc$full_table

# MS1Match evidence per reference row
evidence_cols <- c("grp_anno_match", "exp_anno_match", "NL_match",
                   "ms2_parent_feature", "iso_annotation")
evidence <- anno_result$export_feature_compound_summary %>%
  select(feature_name, Compound_name, any_of(evidence_cols)) %>%
  distinct(feature_name, Compound_name, .keep_all = TRUE)
for (col in setdiff(evidence_cols, names(evidence)))
  evidence[[col]] <- NA_character_

# anchor-cluster properties
anchor_purity <- eval_rc$anchors %>%
  filter(!is.na(anchor_group)) %>%
  count(anchor_group, name = "anchor_cluster_n_compounds")

cluster_size <- grouping_rc %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  count(group, name = "cluster_n_features")

own_confirmed <- ft %>%
  filter(ref_status == "Ref-confirmed") %>%
  count(Compound_name, name = "n_own_confirmed")

mz_rt <- grouping_rc %>% select(feature_name, mz, rt)

# reference rows: one per feature x compound
compound_instance_table_rc <- ft %>%
  filter(!is.na(Compound_name)) %>%
  left_join(mz_rt,         by = "feature_name") %>%
  left_join(evidence,      by = c("feature_name", "Compound_name")) %>%
  left_join(anchor_purity, by = "anchor_group") %>%
  left_join(cluster_size,  by = c("anchor_group" = "group")) %>%
  left_join(own_confirmed, by = "Compound_name") %>%
  mutate(
    .ms2_anno = if_else(
      grepl("^Tier1c", tier) & !is.na(ms2_parent_feature) & ms2_parent_feature != "",
      paste0("MS2 fragment (", ms2_parent_feature, ")"), NA_character_),
    MS1Match_anno = .combine_str(grp_anno_match, exp_anno_match, NL_match, .ms2_anno)
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    compound_instance                         = Compound_name,
    MS1Match_lib_group                        = Lib_group,
    MS1Match_reference_tier                   = reference_tier,
    feature_name, mz, rt,
    MS1Match_anno,
    MS1Match_iso                              = iso_annotation,
    RAMClustR_cluster                         = group,
    RAMClustR_anchor_feature                  = anchor_feature,
    RAMClustR_Anchor_cluster                  = anchor_group,
    RAMClustR_Anchor_cluster_purity           = anchor_cluster_n_compounds,
    RAMClustR_Anchor_cluster_Refconfirmed_pct =
      round(100 * n_own_confirmed / cluster_n_features, 1),
    ref_status
  )

# plus all features outside the reference feature set
outside_rc <- ft %>%
  filter(is.na(Compound_name)) %>%
  left_join(mz_rt, by = "feature_name") %>%
  transmute(feature_name, mz, rt,
            RAMClustR_cluster        = group,
            RAMClustR_Anchor_cluster = anchor_group,
            ref_status)

full_feature_table_rc <- bind_rows(compound_instance_table_rc, outside_rc)

stopifnot(nrow(full_feature_table_rc) == nrow(ft))
```

```{r save-export, eval = FALSE}
output_dir <- paste0("RAMClustR_evaluation_output_SuperPool_", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"))
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

.dash <- function(x) if_else(is.na(x), "-", as.character(x))
dash_cols <- c("compound_instance", "MS1Match_lib_group", "RAMClustR_Anchor_cluster",
               "RAMClustR_Anchor_cluster_purity",
               "RAMClustR_Anchor_cluster_Refconfirmed_pct")

write.csv(eval_rc$benchmark,
          file.path(output_dir, "06_SuperPool_RAMClustR_benchmark_table.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(compound_instance_table_rc %>% mutate(across(any_of(dash_cols), .dash)),
          file.path(output_dir, "07_SuperPool_RAMClustR_compound_instance_table.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(full_feature_table_rc %>% mutate(across(any_of(dash_cols), .dash)),
          file.path(output_dir, "07b_SuperPool_RAMClustR_full_feature_table.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(eval_rc$status_counts,
          file.path(output_dir, "09_SuperPool_RAMClustR_ref_status_counts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(list(eval_rc                    = eval_rc,
             grouping_rc                = grouping_rc,
             clusters_per_compound      = clusters_per_compound,
             compound_instance_table_rc = compound_instance_table_rc,
             full_feature_table_rc      = full_feature_table_rc),
        file.path(output_dir, "RAMClustR_evaluation_SuperPool_all.rds"))
```
